title: Migrate registered master-data print families through one controlled generic catalog
description: Stage 2 migration only through the existing generic reporting platform. Preserve legacy entry points until every fixed/dynamic/export/print family passes real parity. No dedicated report, arbitrary SQL or joins, business workflow changes, schema/seed/protected files, permission expansion, production access or deployment. Preserve concurrent work. Reuse current-user authorization and existing execution/audit conventions; errors must be explicit with correlation evidence. Isolated database writes only after strict LocalDB instance, NEWERP_AUTOTEST_* name and integrated-security guards. Missing real database/browser/artifact parity stays unverified.
implementation_evidence: ReportConfigurationPrintTemplateCatalog.cs BuildFamilies/Master explicitly leaves customer, supplier, employee, expense-account, warehouse, product and other-info unsupported with empty dataset/alias mappings. IErpDbContext already exposes all seven Base* DbSets; no generic master provider exists in Infrastructure/Reports. ERP-312 only inventories and rejects these families; ERP-107 and ERP-306 product completeness are different evidence grain, not master print data. Full backlog and all task definitions/results checked.
acceptance_criteria: Users select any of the seven existing master print families via one finite server-owned catalog and generic preset. Verify authoritative existing field names, order, nulls, soft deletion, labels and aliases against original Base* entities, controllers and print models before implementation; never guess unsupported fields or expose secrets, payroll, bank, credentials or contact fields beyond existing rights. Register exact controlled datasets and print aliases without new dedicated routes.

Every catalog, preview, template bind and export applies the original menu, field and salesperson/customer data scope through existing authorization. Bounded read-only EF queries use stable identifiers, selected authorized columns, cancellation and existing snapshot limits; privileged-only fallback must fail closed where original row ownership cannot be reproduced. Unknown filters/aliases and unavailable sources return precise errors with audit correlation, never full-table fallback.

Reuse generic definitions, Excel/PDF and ERP-313 print layouts. Test all seven catalog mappings and denied/revoked menus/columns, soft deletion, nulls, ordered fields and bounded results; perform nonempty guarded SQL tests across at least two master families plus actual artifacts, related and safe Release tests. Keep financial amounts/unit fields partitioned and legacy entries unchanged; mapping availability does not mark migration parity passed.
